grh_90c6969ec90f599594f8.title: The Lady The Wolf
paragraphs: While Dr. Alexander Webb is temporarily filling in at Rivers End, Judy Price keeps receiving bold telephone calls from Marine Lieutenant Jerry Mitchell, a stranger who has been told about her by a mutual friend. Webb dismisses Jerry as a telephone wolf and warns Judy against meeting him, but Jerry turns out to be a decent, lonely serviceman spending his last night of leave in town. Judy agrees to go dancing with him, leaving Webb with Jerry's unused concert tickets. Webb then telephones a woman he barely knows to offer the tickets and, in the process, gets himself invited to accompany her. Later Judy and Jerry run into Webb and his new companion at the concert, where Webb's attempt to pretend he is a classical-music expert quickly collapses. The comedy leaves Judy amused that the man who lectured her about telephone wolves has been caught in essentially the same sort of spontaneous romance himself.

grh_908cbb74da4b502b9e74.title: Faith, Lime, and Charity
paragraphs: On a train to Agra, Harry meets a woman calling herself Mrs. Halley, who tells him that a mission orphanage has burned and wealthy Lady Edith might donate £5,000 to rebuild it. Harry decides to collect the money himself, but the supposed missionary is actually a confidence woman who intends to take the cash and kill him with the help of Mustafa. Harry escapes by exploiting her fear of snakes, only to be found by police with the money in his coat. Because his testimony finally gives them a case against the woman, Lady Edith believes Harry was her innocent agent and makes him publicly present the real mission with the £5,000, earning him a foundation stone naming Harry Lime as a philanthropist.

grh_90c84df7a231a16d7fbd.title: Gypsy Love
paragraphs: On the eve of his wedding to Maria, gypsy prince Marko collapses with violent weakness that the camp believes is a black spell placed by Sarah, a woman who loves him and has vowed he will marry her or die. Maria secretly summons Dr. Christian despite the band's distrust of outside medicine. He notices that Sarah has been helping nurse Marko and tests the broth she gives him, discovering an obscure drug whose effects have been magnified by Marko's terror of the curse. Dr. Christian and the police stop Sarah before the dosing can become fatal. Marko recovers, Sarah is held until he is out of danger, and Dr. Christian returns to dance at Marko and Maria's wedding.
